correctness.rationale: PASS: The plane gradient (X^s,eta Y^s+Z^s,Y^s) excludes a projective singularity. Choose δ^s+δ=−η to identify the curve geometrically with the Hermitian H; δ^{s²}−δ=η−η^s=b≠0 in the trace-zero translation group U of order s. The Hermitian point count s³+1 forces all q-Frobenius eigenvalues −s. The quotient H/U=P1 kills trivial-character cohomology; scaling x by norm-c elements forces each of s−1 nontrivial character multiplicities to be s. Twisted Frobenius eigenvalues are −sχ(b), giving the claimed cyclotomic product and all-n trace formula. Independently counted 1,9,49 over F4,F16,F64 for p=2,s=2; finite checks are only corroboration.
